title: Monotonicity of neighbor averages
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree, and let $f,g:V\to\mathbb Q$. If $f(v)\le g(v)$ for every vertex $v$, then at every vertex the average of $f$ over the neighbors is at most the corresponding average of $g$.
